rules: The Title Descriptor subset covers all registered titles relating to land or property and normally carries title number, estate and class of title.
An application awaiting registration can have a title number but no estate-interest or class-of-title information.
The dataset also represents registration applications started but not yet completed by HM Land Registry.
Title number is a mandatory character field and uniquely identifies a registered title to land.
Estate Interest is an optional character field.
Class of Title is an optional character field.
Registered status is a mandatory character field.
Registered status value Pending means the application is being processed.
A blank registered-status field means the title is registered.
Change Indicator is a mandatory character field.
Change Indicator records New, Changed or Deleted row states.
Estate-interest code EL means Estate in land.
Estate-interest code FA means Affecting franchise.
Estate-interest code FC means Relating franchise.
Estate-interest code PG means Profit a prendre in gross.
Estate-interest code RP means perpetual rentcharge.
Estate-interest code RT means terminable rentcharge.
Class code AF means absolute freehold title.
Class code QF means qualified freehold title.
Class code PF means possessory freehold title.
The entity-search extension must be json, html or geojson.
geometry_reference filters against geometries of entities with supplied references.
geometry_curie filters against geometries of entities matching supplied CURIEs.
geometry_relation supports within, equals, disjoint, intersects, touches, contains, covers, coveredby, overlaps and crosses.
The quality parameter searches entities by quality values.
The dataset-list extension must be json or html.
The dataset parameter filters the dataset-list response by dataset identifier.
The field parameter selects fields included in dataset JSON responses.
The exclude_field parameter removes fields from dataset JSON responses.
include_typologies can be set false to remove typologies from dataset JSON responses.
The ground-truth archive contains elevation points and attribute information used to verify timestamped LIDAR surveys.
Ground-truth surveys are captured by independent surveyors.
A survey typically contains a few hundred GPS points on flat, unambiguous surfaces such as car parks or tennis courts.
Timestamped LIDAR is compared with ground truth using RMSE, standard deviation and random error.
LIDAR surveys must report less than plus or minus 15cm RMSE and 10cm standard-deviation and random-error values to pass quality control.
The ground-truth dataset is categorised under environment and elevation.
The metadata states there are no public-access constraints.
Use is licensed under the Open Government Licence.
The metadata records an annual update frequency.
OS Terrain 50 contours are supplied as a national GeoPackage file.
The single-file GeoPackage design is intended to be easy to transfer.
GeoPackage attribute names are not constrained by the shapefile ten-character limit.
The documented GeoPackage file-size limit is 140 TB, subject to filesystem limits.
GeoPackage supports raster, vector and database formats.
The contour GeoPackage contains spot_height, land_water_boundary and contour_line layers.
The current GeoPackage schema uses user-friendly snake-case names such as property_value and contour_line_type.
Vector contours are supplied as one national MBTiles file.
The vector-tile supply uses Web Mercator projection EPSG:3857.
Contour, spot-height and land-water attributes are not mapped at zoom 0–8 and are mapped at zoom 9–14.
The OS Terrain 50 online download is available without registration.
